concerns.text: FR-012 (held-out set with heavy-tailed noise) and US-4 Independent Test are unfulfilled. Tasks T034d and T034h are marked unchecked (missing implementation of `validate_heavy_tailed_pareto` and comparison logic). T034c generates the data but no task covers the validation logic required by the spec.

FR-010 (sensitivity analysis on reward distributions: Linear, Sparse, Non-Convex) is partially covered. T034e covers Sparse/Non-Convex, but T034g (Linear distribution generation) and T034f (sensitivity sweep logic) are unchecked, leaving the requirement incomplete.

FR-009 (noise correlation sensitivity analysis) is incomplete. T036 (extend MDP for correlation) and T052b (run sweep) are unchecked. T052c (KS-test implementation) is also unchecked, preventing the verification of the independence assumption.

SC-002 (coincidence check) verification is blocked. T043 (determine failure point) is unchecked. While T042b (coincidence check function) is checked, it depends on T035 (logging empirical results) which is unchecked, creating a dependency gap for the final success criterion.

FR-001 (closed-form variance equation) and SC-001 (symbolic verification) are blocked. T026b (symbolic engine verification) is unchecked, and T018 (variance_scaling.py) is marked as incomplete/unverified in the analyze report, leaving no valid implementation path for the core theoretical derivation.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) is at risk. T001 (Initialize project directory structure) is unchecked, meaning the foundational file structure required for all subsequent tasks does not have a corresponding task to create it.

Task T016 (Moving-Window Heuristic) has a comment 'FAILED: unspecified' but is not explicitly listed as rejected or re-planned. This ambiguity makes it unclear if the task is complete or requires a new task definition.
